user.title: Connect to the Sophos Firewall
user.description: The XML API must be enabled on the firewall and this Home Assistant's IP address must be allowed in the API configuration.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the firewall.
data_description.port: Port of the web admin console / XML API, usually 4444.
data_description.username: A firewall administrator. A dedicated API administrator with a read-only profile is recommended (read/write only if you enable write access).
data_description.verify_ssl: Leave off for the firewall's self-signed certificate. Turn on if the firewall uses a certificate trusted by Home Assistant.

snmp.title: SNMP (optional)
snmp.description: SNMP provides the metrics the XML API does not offer.

data_description.snmp_enabled: Adds system statistics, services, VPN connections, hardware health and licenses. Requires an SNMPv2c agent on the firewall with Home Assistant as allowed manager.
data_description.snmp_community: The SNMPv2c community configured on the firewall.

write_access.title: Write access (optional)
write_access.description: Switches change the live firewall configuration. Only enable this if Home Assistant should be able to do that.

data_description.write_access: Creates switches to enable/disable firewall rules and to set the default action of web filter policies. Requires an administrator with write permission.

polling.title: Polling
polling.description: How often which data is read. The defaults suit most installations.

realtime.name: Realtime
realtime.description: Polled on every run — the base interval of the integration.

data_description.interval_realtime: 10–300 s. All other tiers are checked on these runs.
data_description.poll_xml_interfaces: Link state, zone and IP assignment of every interface. Also decides which interfaces get their traffic rates enabled by default (only the ones listed here).
data_description.poll_snmp_stats: CPU, RAM, disk and swap usage, last boot, captive portal users and protocol hit counters.
data_description.poll_snmp_services: State of the 21 firewall services (IPS, AV, DNS, VPN, …).
data_description.poll_snmp_traffic: Receive/transmit rate and byte counters of every interface (IF-MIB).

data_description.poll_snmp_tunnels: One connectivity sensor per IPsec connection.
data_description.poll_snmp_ha: Only useful if the firewall runs as a high-availability pair.

data_description.interval_operative: 60–3600 s. A switch toggled in Home Assistant is re-read immediately.
data_description.poll_xml_fw_rules: Enabled/disabled state of every firewall rule.
data_description.poll_snmp_health: Temperatures, fans and power supplies. Stops automatically on virtual appliances.

data_description.interval_static: 300–86400 s. Hostname, model and firmware are also read at this interval.
data_description.poll_xml_dhcp: State of every DHCP server and its static leases.
data_description.poll_xml_webfilter: Default action (allow/deny) of every web filter policy.
data_description.poll_snmp_licenses: Status and expiry date of every subscription module.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate
reauth_confirm.description: The firewall at {host} rejected the password of **{username}**. Enter the current password.

reconfigure.title: Change connection
reconfigure.description: Connection settings for the firewall currently at {host}. Entities and their history are kept.

error.invalid_auth: The firewall rejected the username or password.
error.api_access_denied: The firewall denies API access. Enable the XML API and allow this Home Assistant's IP address in the firewall's API configuration.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the firewall. Check host and port.
error.snmp_cannot_connect: The SNMP agent does not answer. Check that SNMP is enabled on the firewall, the community string and that Home Assistant is an allowed manager.
error.unknown: Unexpected error — see the Home Assistant log.

auth_failed.message: Authentication failed — the integration is paused until the credentials are updated.

xml_unreachable.message: The XML API of the Sophos Firewall at {host} is not reachable: {error}

snmp_unreachable.message: The SNMP agent of the Sophos Firewall at {host} is not answering: {error}

api_access_denied.message: The Sophos Firewall at {host} denies API access (code {code}). Enable the XML API and add this Home Assistant's IP address to the allowed addresses in the firewall's API configuration.

backup_failed.message: Failed to trigger the backup: {error}. Check the firewall's backup configuration (e.g. the mail server for email backups).

no_data.message: The Sophos Firewall at {host} returned no usable data: {error}

api_access_denied.title: {title}: API access denied
api_access_denied.description:
The Sophos Firewall at {host} rejects the API requests of Home Assistant (status code {code}).

On the firewall, open **Backup & firmware > API**, enable the API configuration and add the IP address of Home Assistant to the allowed IP addresses.

The integration keeps retrying; this message disappears as soon as access works.

snmp_unreachable.title: {title}: SNMP agent not answering
snmp_unreachable.description:
The SNMP agent of the Sophos Firewall at {host} has not answered for more than 10 minutes since the integration started, so all SNMP sensors are unavailable.

Check on the firewall:
- **Administration > SNMP**: the SNMP agent is enabled, and an SNMPv1/v2c community exists whose name matches the community configured in Home Assistant and whose IP address is the one of Home Assistant.
- **Administration > Device access**: SNMP is allowed for the zone Home Assistant is in.

If you do not use SNMP, turn it off in the integration's options. This message disappears as soon as the agent answers.
